csv_scope_of_work: Beaufort County seeks to procure design-build services for the development of new aircraft storage facilities at Beaufort Executive Airport (ARW), located at 39 Airport Circle, Beaufort, South Carolina 29907. The project includes the design and construction of an eight-bay T-hangar and a 50-foot by 50-foot box hangar to support based general aviation aircraft storage, accommodate a variety of aircraft types, enhance airport operational efficiency, and generate additional airport revenue.
